findings.evidence: MomentDeterminacy.lean:124 states the kernel result; the only consumer path is line 167 `simpa using congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hker) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn⟩`; no `mem_ker` lemma exists in the file.
findings.fix: Add `theorem mem_ker_polynomialMomentsIcc_iff {p : Polynomial ℝ} : p ∈ LinearMap.ker (polynomialMomentsIcc a b N) ↔ ∀ n ≤ N, ∫ x in Icc a b, x ^ n * p.eval x = 0`, and use it at line 167.
findings.issue: `ker_polynomialMomentsIcc_inf_degreeLT_ne_bot` is a listed main result delivering membership in `LinearMap.ker (polynomialMomentsIcc a b N)`, but nothing publicly states what that membership means: there is no `mem_ker_polynomialMomentsIcc_iff`. Since the `polynomialMomentsIcc` body is (correctly) not exposed, every consumer must redo the plumbing the author does inline at line 167 (`congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hker) ⟨n, _⟩` plus `simpa`).

findings.evidence: Determinacy.lean:106 defines `Model.ofPolynomial` under plain `public section` (no `@[expose]`, unlike `GPD/Basic.lean:30` `@[expose] public section`); only `ofPolynomial_E` (111), `ofPolynomial_H_of_mem_Icc` (130) and `mellinMomentH_ofPolynomial` (146, `hxi : |xi| ≤ 1`) are exported.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma Model.ofPolynomial_H : (Model.ofPolynomial p F).H i x xi t = if 1 < |xi| then 0 else (Icc (0:ℝ) 1).indicator (fun y => p.eval y) x := (rfl)` (or, failing that, `mellinMomentH_ofPolynomial_of_one_lt_abs`), and replace the in-file `simp [Model.ofPolynomial, …]` unfoldings with it.
findings.issue: `Model.ofPolynomial` has no `*_def` lemma for `H`. Its body is unexposed, yet the file's own proofs unfold it seven times (`simp [Model.ofPolynomial, ...]` at lines 124, 126, 133, 140, 141, 155, 156, 204) — including line 204, where the `1 < |xi|` branch of the moment is computed by unfolding because `mellinMomentH_ofPolynomial` (line 146) is stated only for `|xi| ≤ 1`. A downstream user has no simp normal form for `(Model.ofPolynomial p F).H` and must reconstruct the `|ξ| > 1` moment from `assumptions_ofPolynomial.skewnessBound` by hand.

summary: Surface is otherwise minimal and shim-free with bodies correctly unexposed, but two advertised public objects lack their characteristic lemmas: the kernel of `polynomialMomentsIcc` has no membership restatement, and `Model.ofPolynomial` has no defining equation for `H`, so the file's own proofs unfold a body downstream cannot see.
